_comment: Melbourne — generation-A workbook. NOT YET IMPORTED. Read-only projection only. envelope is NOW SET (derived 2026-07-31 from the MSA county list, not from the observed bbox) — see _envelope_comment for the counties used, the derivation rule and the containment cross-check.
_envelope_comment: Derived from the Palm Bay-Melbourne-Titusville, FL MSA COUNTY LIST, not from the observed venue bounding box. The observed bbox is only a LOWER bound — it says where the venues we happened to find are, not where the metro is, so an envelope cut to it would reject a legitimate future venue near the metro edge. Envelope = the union of the OSM boundary-polygon bounding boxes for the 1 MSA county (Brevard)), rounded OUTWARD to 0.01 deg. Cross-check: contains all 13 geocoded venue(s) of 15 in this batch (observed lat 28.0093..28.6235, lng -80.8393..-80.5863).

same_site_pairs.note: Cocoa Beach Recreation Center / Tennis & Pickleball Complex (321 Ramp Road, 12 courts, fee) and Ramp Road Park (401 Ramp Road, outdoor) are distinct city facilities with distinct house numbers on the same road; the city lists them separately at https://www.cityofcocoabeach.com/547/Parks-with-Tennis-Pickleball-Courts. They geocoded 83 m apart onto the same OSM way.
